capture_platform_requirement: Record platform and source commit honestly; web footage requires comparison with the signed Android build before store use.

segments.caption: One letter. Two new words.
segments.supporting_caption: Both results must be valid words.
segments.picture: Actual PLAY/PANT board. Select L, show its valid insertion, move it into PANT, and hold the genuine PAY/PLANT result long enough to read.
segments.source_requirement: Continuous real screen recording of the legal move; no reconstructed tile motion.
segments.audio: Existing letter-select and valid-move sounds if recorded or synchronized accurately.

segments.caption: Turn words into a home.
segments.picture: Continue the actual chain to its solved state and show the genuine reward transition.
segments.source_requirement: Actual completion and reward; do not invent an amber total or room unlock.

segments.caption: Meet 13 unlikely friends.
segments.picture: Bright inhabited house, with a slow real scroll and the new normal walking animations visible.
segments.source_requirement: Actual home footage from the selected source commit. Do not composite animation sprites into a different scene.
segments.audio: Existing game ambience or owned soundtrack.

segments.caption: A little place to return to.
segments.picture: A short, warm early conversation, then a real equipped tile style or completed room gift.
segments.source_requirement: Readability first; use a short dialogue that fits the current UI. Real installed style or gift payoff.
segments.audio: Continue the same warm bed; no voice acting implied.

segments.caption: A new challenge.
segments.picture: Regular Daily Challenge board in progress.
segments.source_requirement: Real current daily state with transient bonuses absent.

segments.caption: A different twist.
segments.picture: Real Double Shift action, two selected letters and a legal move.
segments.source_requirement: Instructions dismissed; enough time to see the two-letter action.
segments.audio: Existing move sound only if it matches the shown action.

segments.caption: A cozy game. Mostly.
segments.picture: Cut to the actual house at phase-3 pre-storm night. Hold the glowing rooms against the dark sky.
segments.source_requirement: Actual early night footage, normal residents; no robes, late reveal, ritual close-up or invented shadow.
segments.audio: Lower the warm bed subtly; no jump scare.

segments.caption: What changes after dark?
segments.picture: Continue the same night footage. A subtle actual star glint or resident movement gives the scene life.
segments.source_requirement: No added night effects or clues that the game does not contain.
segments.audio: Leave a little space in the music; keep the cut gentle.

segments.caption: A little wordplay. A world to uncover.
segments.picture: WordShift wordmark over the continuing actual house footage, with a clean end.
segments.source_requirement: Do not replace the last three seconds with a static promotional slate.
segments.audio: Gentle resolve/fade with no hard truncation.
